name: B10-0135/2025 (ECR) – Repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Nicaragua's government, led by Daniel Ortega and his wife Rosario Murillo, for jailing, exiling and stripping citizenship from opponents, journalists, human rights defenders and religious figures, including Catholic priests and nuns. It asks Nicaragua to release all political and religious prisoners, restore citizenship to those who lost it, let closed charities and churches reopen, and end the repression. It also asks the European Union to sanction more people and groups linked to the regime.

- The European Union is asked to add more names to its sanctions list against Nicaragua's regime.
- Nicaragua's government is urged to free prisoners, restore citizenships and reopen closed groups.
- Nothing changes immediately; the Parliament is stating demands, not passing law.
